summary: Tested SIPRO iteration 15 features A (Lingkup Peran Bawaan - built-in role scope editor) and B (Langkah Tanpa RAB - RAB rows/steps sync). All 11 backend pytest cases pass; UI flows for both features pass end-to-end. Sales scope enforcement verified: default 'own' -> scope 'all' widens sales' /api/leads visibility, and /api/auth/me reflects role_scope live without re-login. RAB steps_without_rab count decrements when a chip is added and drops to 0 after 'Tambah semua' + save. Cleanup performed: TIPE-36-72 and TIPE-45-90 items cleared, sales scope restored to 'own'.

design_issues.screen: RAB / BoQ (RAB Unit dialog or Admin permissions Select)
issues: Console React hydration warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Native <option> element contains a <span>, causes hydration warning. Likely in a select rendering scope labels or step options. Not functional-blocking but should be cleaned up.

action_items: Fix React hydration warning: replace <span> inside <option> with plain text or use a custom Select component (not a native <option>) in whichever select renders scope/step choices (likely a fallback native select somewhere).
critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/admin/roles/{code} correctly rejects label edits for built-in roles (400) and invalid scope values; full-access roles owner/super_admin cannot be scope-restricted — good.
role_scope override persists via permission_settings (role_scope_overrides) and /api/auth/me reflects the change without token refresh — good UX.
RAB PUT /api/rab/templates/unit_type/{ref_code} accepts unit_price=0 (test used 1_000_000; UI save with unit_price 0 also produced 'RAB tersimpan') — confirm this is intentional or add validation.
seed_data_creation: None. Test added and then removed RAB items on TIPE-36-72 and TIPE-45-90; sales role scope override was toggled and then restored to 'own' (default).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature A + B fully verified. Backend pytest lives at /app/backend/tests/test_iter15_features.py. Note: RAB list rows use key 'ref_code' (not 'code'/'type_code'). The RAB template PUT endpoint replaces the items array. Cleanup step is important to keep TIPE-36-72 items=0 (baseline 20 steps_without_rab) for future re-runs.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. Only a non-blocking React hydration warning surfaced in console (<span> inside <option>).
